name: D.Nd: Poisoned
source:
When Roger decides to assign Mello and Near a project they must work in together, they might be able to discover the greatest mystery of their lives: Each other.

However the chemical reaction as result of their relationship might not be the desired result Roger was looking for...

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120125050100/http://www.cursedmoons.com/fan/game/poisoned/main.htm]Official Site[/url]]
